description: This file defines the `ColorScaler` utility class in Java, which provides methods to compute scaled colors based on a given scale value, using settings for minimum and maximum colors. It includes a method to convert RGB colors to HSB and calculates interpolated colors according to the scale.

classes.name: ColorScaler
classes.description: A utility class for color scaling, providing static methods to generate interpolated colors based on a scale parameter.

methods.name: getScaledColor
methods.description: Returns a color scaled according to the provided scale value, interpolating between minimum and maximum colors defined in settings.

methods.name: rgbToHsb
methods.description: Converts an RGB Color object to its corresponding HSB float array representation.
